messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Active auto insurance policies in area: 22. Cancellations increasing.
People around you are stressed: Rick Tanner, Tom Bradley. The mood is tense.

Linda sent Tom Bradley's introductions to the regional logistics contact as promised, keeping her credibility intact at no real cost. The municipal risk management call — framed around Millfield's RoboRide licensing exposure — produced the most substantive conversation of the three external threads: the contact acknowledged that yes, the city's risk profile has shifted and there is a budget review underway, stopping short of a job but clearly engaging with Linda as a subject-matter peer. Priya shared that she has been applying to two insurtech roles and neither has a strong risk-management bench — intelligence Linda immediately maps to her own targeting. The CRMP commercial lines module is logged at 40% completion, eight months in, now credentialing directly into the space her strongest lead is developing.
